oss.description: Leonida Is A Native PC Recompilation Of The Xbox Version Of Grand Theft Auto 6
oss.readme:
Leonida
  

Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series) running natively on Windows, built on your PC from your own copy.

  Other languages |
  Status |
  How to build |
  How it works |
  Want to help? |
  Credits |
  License |
  Discord

Leonida is a static recompilation project. The Xbox Series CPU is x86-64 like a PC, so the game's code is loaded
and run natively, and the console's system software is reimplemented. The console's precompiled RDNA2 GPU programs
are translated to SPIR-V for Vulkan. The game's models, textures and audio are read from your package. All of this
happens **on your PC, from your own copy of the game**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This repository **does not contain the game, keys or an executable**, and it does not explain how to get them. You
> need your own copy, with its files already readable on disk. Nothing here decrypts or works around any protection.
> Everything the build creates (the generated shaders, extracted assets, the runtime folder and your saves) comes
> from your game and stays on your PC. Never share those files.

Discord: https://discord.gg/rexed

## Project status

**Early. The game does not boot yet.** Everything that can be done without the game's executable is in place, so
work on booting can start as soon as one is available to a developer.

| What | Status |
|---|---|
| Booting, story mode, anything playable | ❌ No |
| Finding and checking your copy (Xbox Series 1.0.2.1) | ✅ Works |
| Shaders: carve, unpack native RDNA2 code, disassemble | ✅ All 26,503 |
| Shaders: RDNA2 → SPIR-V translation | ✅ **All 26,503 translated**: 2,236 VS, 12,101 PS, 2,689 CS, 9,282 mesh, 195 geometry, with a per-shader metadata index for pipeline creation. All 26,503 passed `spirv-val` in the [LLVM 23.1.5 Linux run at `c432cdc`](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/644#issuecomment-7072972586). A [full-corpus run at `43d4703`](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/881#issuecomment-7075507328) also validated all 26,503 after `dcd8ecf` fixed the SPIR-V ID bound; the intervening `dedd75c` run was 26,501. ⚠️ 23,841 are wave64 (the FSSM header's wave-size flag; [docs/design.md](docs/design.md), "Wave size"): exact on 64-wide subgroups (AMD). On 32-wide subgroups (NVIDIA, Intel), compute and mesh shaders are exact with wave64 emulation (`--wave64-emulate`, on by default there); cross-half wave ops in vertex, pixel and geometry shaders are still approximate |
| Shaders: RDNA2 → SPIR-V translation | ✅ **26,503 / 26,503 translated**: 2,236 VS, 12,101 PS, 2,689 CS, 9,282 mesh, 195 geometry, with a per-shader metadata index for pipeline creation. The LLVM 23.1.5 Linux rerun at `c432cdc` and the LLVM 23.1.3 Windows rerun at `43d0015` both translated all 26,503 ([Linux](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/644#issuecomment-7072972586), [Windows](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/644#issuecomment-7074299915)). Translation and SPIR-V validation are separate steps; validation results are listed below. ⚠️ 21,545 are wave64: exact on 64-wide subgroups (AMD). On 32-wide subgroups (NVIDIA, Intel), compute and mesh shaders are exact with wave64 emulation (`--wave64-emulate`, on by default there); cross-half wave ops in vertex, pixel and geometry shaders are still approximate |
| SPIR-V validation (`spirv-val`) | ✅ **26,503 / 26,503 passed** in the LLVM 23.1.5 Linux rerun at `c432cdc` and in the full-corpus rerun at `43d4703`, after `dcd8ecf` fixed the SPIR-V ID-bound error ([Linux rerun](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/644#issuecomment-7072972586), [full-corpus rerun](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/881#issuecomment-7075507328)). On Windows at `43d0015`, all 26,503 translated but 26,501 passed validation; the two ID-bound failures were fixed by `dcd8ecf`. The intermediate `dedd75c` run also passed 26,501. |
| Shader translator checked on a real GPU | ⚠️ The hand-written GPU tests (vertex fetch, texture sampling, exports, ALU ops, partial-register ops, barycentrics, wave-uniform branches, compute LDS/barriers/buffer stores, wave64 masks) have been run on more than 30 GPU and driver combinations, with results in [#166](https://github.com/ItsNotRexed/Leonida/issues/166): NVIDIA Turing, Ampere, Ada and Blackwell (Windows and Linux); AMD GCN3, RDNA1, RDNA2, RDNA3 and RDNA4 (Windows driver and RADV); Intel Gen9 (ANV); Apple M1 (MoltenVK, no geometry or mesh stages); and Mesa llvmpipe. Wave64 tests need 64-wide subgroups (AMD) or `LEONIDA_W64_EMULATE=1`. These are small test shaders: the game's own shaders are checked by `spirv-val` and by driver pipeline creation (`vk_pipeline_check`), not by their output |
| Models (OBJ with real names, UVs, material references) | ✅ Exported. A ten-archive scan at decoder pin `e293917` recovered **382,781 models** with zero readback decode failures. This includes **343,327** models from `levels.rpf`. A full OBJ export of that archive is pending. See [recount and export scope](docs/models.md#full-archive-re-count-at-e293917). |
| Texture dictionaries and world texture pools (DDS) | ✅ Exported. Pool entries stored as BCPack are still skipped by the export; a clean-room decoder (`tools/bcpack.py`) rebuilds BC1, BC3, BC4, BC5, BC6H and BC7 (most BC6H/BC7 chunks need a local history table, which the repo does not ship), and is not wired into `rpf9dump` yet ([notes](docs/textures.md)) |
| Audio banks (AWC: Opus, XMA2) | ✅ Exported whole. Opus repackaged **losslessly** as Ogg Opus; PCM (codec 0/2) as WAV; XMA2 decoded with ffmpeg. `--wav` adds 16-bit PCM WAV ([notes](docs/audio.md)) |
| Music/radio config | ? Measured. **1,589** audio-config records with exact durations and AWC stream ids; station grouping and content-id lists; no per-track start offsets ([notes](docs/audio_config.md)) |
| PE loader and import shims | ⚠️ Runs a stand-in executable end to end (`gta6rt --run`: CRT startup, statics, heap, files, threads, GDK imports through the shims, exit code back). Controllers through a GameInp

# Mister Download Manager

  

Downloads faster than IDM. Free, forever.

🌐 misterdownloadmanager.com: the official website, with the downloads, help and news

  Windows 10 and 11 (x64, ARM64, 32-bit) · Linux (Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch and more; x86-64 and ARM64) · macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, experimental)
  86 languages · no ads, no trial, no sign-up

  
    5×Fastera 1 GB file: 1 s instead of 5.5 s, on a local test server
    +46More languages86 instead of IDM's 40
    100%Cheaper (free!)no licence, no trial, ever
    TorrentSupported fullymagnet links, .torrent files, seeding
  

  
    
    
  

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

| 🚀 [Download](#download) | ⚡ [Why switch](#why-switch-from-idm) | 🖼️ [Screenshots](#screenshots) | ✨ [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) | 📜 [Help and tutorials](docs/README.md) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Why switch from IDM?

**Same window you know. Your downloads finish sooner. And it costs nothing.**

  
    
    
  

| | Mister Download Manager | IDM 6.42 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Download a big file (1 GB) | **1 second** | 5.5 seconds |
| Download a small file | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Download over a shaky connection | **1.6 seconds** | 5.4 seconds |
| Wait before a download starts | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Price | **Free, forever** | Paid, after a 30-day trial |
| Ads, nag screens, sign-up | **None** | Registration needed |
| Open source | **Yes** (GPL) | No |

Nothing new to learn: the toolbar, the categories, the list of downloads, the progress window and
the browser button are where you expect them. Measured on the same computer, downloading from a
test server on that computer (a loopback test: it times the programs, not an internet connection),
same files, both programs at their default settings ([how we measured](#the-benchmark-in-detail)).

## Download

  
  
  

On the [download page](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/releases/latest), pick
one:

| File | Choose it when |
| --- | --- |
| **`...-setup.exe`** | **Not sure? Take this one.** It installs MDM, connects it to your browser and asks your language. |
| `...-portable.zip` | You want MDM on a USB stick or without installing: unzip and run. Everything stays in its folder. |
| `...-x64.zip` | You want the plain programs without an installer. |
| `...-setup-arm64.exe`, `...-portable-arm64.zip`, `...-arm64.zip` | The same three for **Windows on ARM** (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs). |
| `...-setup-x86.exe`, `...-portable-x86.zip`, `...-x86.zip` | The same three for **32-bit Windows 10**. There, choose your own ffmpeg in **Helpers** for the best video qualities: none is built for it that MDM can check. |
| `...-extension-chromium.zip` | You want to add the browser extension by hand (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi). From the stores is easier: [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mister-download-manager/ejoleppdfgjdndddcjoehopknmlglojp), [Add to Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/mister-download-manager/). |

The ARM64 and 32-bit files come with every release after 0.5.2; **Check for updates** keeps each
copy on its own processor's files.

> [!NOTE]
> Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* the first time, because this early version isn't
> code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Or with [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/), Windows' package
manager: in a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it.

```
winget install AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
winget upgrade AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
```

### Code signing policy

Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org).
Which Windows files are signed, who reviews and approves them, and what MDM sends over the
network: [code signing policy](https://misterdownloadmanager.com/code-signing-policy.html).

### On Linux

MDM runs on Linux too, tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora with GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce
and Cinnamon, on X11 and in Wayland sessions: the tray, dark mode, browser integration (Ubuntu's
Snap Firefox included) and the packages' installs. Not there yet: screen readers (Orca) don't
read its windows, and Flatpak browsers can't reach it ([more](docs/getting-started.md#on-linux)).
Up to version 0.2.4, the files' names end in `-experimental`.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-linux-x86_64.deb` | Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS: `sudo apt install ./.deb`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./.rpm`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | Any Linux. Make it executable and run it. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | The plain programs, for any distribution. |
| `...-linux-arm64.*` | The same four for 64-bit ARM computers, from the release after 0.5.2 (built and tested on GitHub's ARM machines). |

  
    
    
  

### On a Mac? Be the first to try it

Fresh builds for **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) are on the same download page, marked
`-experimental`: we haven't tried them on a Mac ourselves yet. Give them a go and
[tell us how it went](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/new/choose); you'll
help make them as solid as the Windows and Linux versions.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-macos-arm64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Open it and drag MDM to Applications. The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**. |
| `...-macos-x86_64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with an Intel processor, the same way. |

## 🌍 In your language

Every language Windows 11 offers, **86 in all**. MDM asks on its first start, and you can change
it any time in **View → Language**.

oss.readme:
Craft Anything

  English · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Tiếng Việt · Português · ไทย · Türkçe

  See how any website, app or game works, then have AI build your own version; an open-source, clean-room engine in pure Rust.
  Point it at a target, say what you want, and it studies the original with real inspection tools,
  has a coding agent build a new project, checks the result against the original and refines it.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  

  Download Craft Anything ·
  ArtCraft ·
  All Crafting Apps

  
  
  A website project: each check says how alike the build is, you approve anything outside the rules, and the plan shows what's left.

> [!NOTE]
> **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers,
> filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil
> last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

  How it works ·
  Two ways to use it ·
  AI ·
  Agents ·
  Under the hood ·
  Get started ·
  Status ·
  Downloads ·
  Discord

  
    
      🔍 Study anything
      Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.
    
    
      🛠️ Build your own
      Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.
    
    
      ✅ Checked, not guessed
      Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.
    
    
      🤖 Agent-ready
      320 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.
    
  

## How it works

Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps,
asking you in plain words when a decision is yours:

1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs.
2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your
   request names (or a sensible default).
3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet.
4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

  
    
      
      Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
    
    
      
      Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
    
  

## Two ways to use it

- **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it,
  press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the
  agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and
  buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom.
  "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode).
- **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C,
  disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console.

Both modes drive the same engine.

## Clean room or Deep

- **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page
  source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor
  sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened)
  and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused

oss.readme:
rust-anything

Rewrite your app in Rust, and prove it still behaves the same.
Point it at your app: it records what the original does, your coding agent writes the Rust one piece at a time,
and every piece is checked against that recording before it moves on. It doesn't translate code; it proves the rewrite.

  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

Install · Releases · Claude Code plugin · MCP Registry · Real-world ports · FAQ
Languages · How it works · Whole apps · Sponsors · MIT
Made in Türkiye 🇹🇷 by erKam Yaman · ❤️ Sponsor me · Sponsored by  CodeRabbit

New in 2.0: Prettier, ported to Rust. 19x faster · 15,861 of 17,224 recorded runs fully in Rust · every run byte-identical

  
  
  Prettier against its Rust port on 59 real files from ms, Fuse.js and json-server (Apple M4). Same output, byte for byte. How it was measured.

PHP and C#: unit ports, through FFI and P/Invoke.

  
    
      Record
      record runs the original on generated edge cases, semantic traps and your own inputs, and saves what it returns or throws.
    
    
      Port
      bridge generates the Rust crate and a wrapper, so callers keep the original API. You or your agent write the Rust.
    
    
      Check
      diff replays every recorded case against the Rust, and nothing ships until they all match and gate passes.
    
    
      Lift
      When replay passes with no fallback and every unit passes gate, app lift makes it a pure Rust app. The original is never touched.
    
  

**Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time.** rust-anything records what your
Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript), Python, C, Go, Ruby, Java or Kotlin app does today, then checks every piece of the
Rust rewrite against that recording before it moves on, until the app is pure Rust. CLIs, HTTP
servers and libraries; your coding agent (or you) writes the Rust. It is built on
[napi-rs](https://github.com/napi-rs/napi-rs), [PyO3](https://github.com/PyO3/pyo3) and
[wasm-bindgen](https://github.com/wasm-bindgen/wasm-bindgen), which carry the calls between your
language and Rust; rust-anything decides what to move and proves it matches. It can only catch what the
recording covers: see [What it can't catch](docs/how-it-works.md#what-it-cant-catch). Whole tools
and servers, or only the slow part, one hot path at a time:

| Real project, same output as the original | Original | With rust-anything |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| [Prettier](docs/real-world.md#prettier) 3.6.2, 2,360 JS/TS files from the command line | 128.6 s | **6.9 s: 19x faster** |
| Prettier, 6,305 Markdown files from the command line | 352 s | **22.5 s: 15.6x faster** |
| [json-server](docs/real-world.md#json-server), a whole Node server: memory at idle | 74 MB | **3.5 MB**, one 5.3 MB binary |
| json-server, from start to first response | 79 to 85 ms | **8 to 10 ms** |
| [Fuse.js](docs/real-world.md#fusejs) search over 50,000 strings, per query | 91.2 ms | **2.8 ms: 32x faster** |

Prettier: 15,861 of 17,224 recorded runs format fully in Rust across 10 languages (JavaScript,
TypeScript, JSX, JSON, GraphQL, YAML, Markdown, CSS, SCSS, Less), and all 17,224 match Prettier
byte for byte, since anything not ported yet falls back to Prettier. json-server: 514/514
recorded HTTP cases match on a pure Rust binary. Measured on an Apple M4, two runs each, every
output compared before timing ([details](docs/real-world.md)). Calling Rust once per small
function is usually *slower* than a JIT; rust-anything finds the loop worth moving, and moves it. Against
C the win is safety, not speed: [ffmpeg's libavutil](docs/real-world.md#ffmpeg) ported to Rust
matches all 226,447 recorded calls and runs at about C's speed (18 of 42 benchmarks even, 8
faster, 16 slower by 3 to 40%).

## Only the slow part

You don't have to port the whole app. Point `go` at a command that is too slow, and it ports
the one function that takes the time:

```sh
rust-anything go --agent claude -- python3 app.py
```

It profiles the run, picks the outermost function worth moving (the loop, not the small call
inside it, batched where the profile says so), records it on generated inputs plus the calls your
run makes, and hands `src/port.rs` to your agent (`claude`, `codex`, or any command that reads a
prompt on stdin; without `--agent` it writes `TASK.md` for you and stops). It switches the
function on only when every recorded case matches and `gate` passes. Then:

```sh
rust-anything report rust/dedupe-rs     # REPORT.md and card.svg for the pull request
rust-anything disable rust/dedupe-rs    # back to the original, byte for byte
```

The [Fuse.js](docs/real-world.md#fusejs) row above is this shape: Fuse's score for one string,
batched over the list, moved to Rust while object keys, extended search and the rest stay in
JavaScript, for 91.2 ms to 2.8 ms per query over 50,000 strings. Try `go` on
[`tests/fixtures/go-fuzzy`](tests/fixtures/go-fuzzy), a 20-line Python dedupe. Every way to switch
a port on and off: [Switch a port on and off](docs/how-it-works.md#switch-a-port-on-and-off).

  
  
  json-server, a whole Node server, lifted to a pure Rust binary (Apple M4). How it was measured.

> [!WARNING]
> `record` and `app record` run your original code, calling each function (or the whole app) on
> many generated inputs, and `app record` runs every case twice. `diff`, `gate` and `app replay`
> run the same cases again, on the port or the original. Code that writes files, talks to a
> database or calls the network does that once per case. Run them on a copy of the project, with a
> test database and no production credentials in the environment.

## 可以做什么

DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。

- **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。
- **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。
- **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。
- **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。
- **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。
- **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。

功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。

## 安装

安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。
2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。
3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。

仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。

本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。

## 常见问题

和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？

没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。

安全吗？

本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。

切到后台会被杀吗？

部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。

对手机有什么要求？

Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。

开源吗？

开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。再发布和 fork 时的署名要求见[授权范围与再发布](#授权范围与再发布)。

## 从源码构建

以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。

先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git
cd dsh-go

bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh
source tooling/env.sh
flutter --version
java -version

bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon
```

工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。

产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。

构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时：

```bash
bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon
```

未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。

只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行：

```bash
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all
```

**应用不内置内容源，不分发第三方插件，也不提供官方源列表。** 首次使用需自行导入插件，无需注册 HGhub 账号；来源要求登录时，由对应插件提供登录入口。

## 核心体验

- **沉浸式播放**：桌面与移动端界面，配合手势和播放控制，在面板中查看详情、选集与评论。
- **多来源浏览与搜索**：推荐、分类筛选和聚合搜索，支持按来源查看结果，并保留本地搜索历史。
- **灵活的播放选择**：支持 HLS 与普通视频，切换线路、清晰度和解析器，也可搜索其他来源继续观看。
- **自己的片库**：管理本地收藏、观看历史与续播进度；支持追更，以及将插件提供的云端列表导入本地收藏。
- **按需扩展**：通过文件、网址或插件列表导入内容源与解析器，检查更新，并在更新失败时恢复上一可用版本。
- **更多内容形式**：除点播外，还可通过插件接入直播、信息流和图文内容。

具体内容、账号、评论与互动能力取决于所安装的插件。

## 开始使用

插件版处于早期开发阶段，目前可[从源码运行或构建](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。当前重点完善 Windows 与 Android，其他平台仍在适配和验证；详见[支持状态](docs/developers/status.md)。

1. 打开 **插件中心 → 导入与订阅**。移动端从“我的”进入插件中心。
2. 选择插件文件、粘贴代码，或输入插件／列表网址；确认安装并启用。
3. 从首页、搜索或分类找到内容，开始播放。需要切换首页来源时，可在设置中选择。

HGhub 维护播放器与插件接口，第三方内容的可用性由相应来源决定。

客户端使用 **Rust · Tauri 2 · React · TypeScript** 构建。HPP 插件协议仍在演进，编写插件前请阅读当前支持状态。

## 参与、交流、贡献

欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/Minireel/HGhub/issues) 反馈问题、提出想法，或提交 [Pull Request](https://github.com/Minireel/HGhub/pulls) 参与改进。报告问题时，请附上应用版本、操作系统和复现步骤。

- Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after `claude auth login`, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway

- Self-hosted runner: Added `--start-dir` / `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_START_DIR` to have Claude start its work in a folder of a repository, while settings and hooks load as without it
- Added a notice in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions when a plugin marketplace can't be fetched because its repository isn't one of the session's
- Self-hosted runner: Added a notice when Anthropic-managed git refuses a plugin's own repository, naming the plugin and what to do
- Added `commandPrinted` to `claude plugin install --json` results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and `commandFailed` when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out

- Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order to first session handed over, on runners started for a session
